abstract: We search for violations of the Equivalence Principle towards the Sun using a rotating torsion balance apparatus. We set 95%-confidence limits on violations with beryllium and aluminum test bodies of $η_{\odot, Be-Al} \leq 2.1 \times 10^{-13}$. These results are a factor of four improvement of previously reported results towards the Sun and a $\sim20\%$ improvement on previous torsion balance tests regardless of source.
title: An Improved Torsion Balance Test of the Equivalence Principle Towards the Sun
